# Our Family Socials: a private family social network
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/

Never miss your family's greatest adventures. Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network for families to share life events, photos and stories with each other instead of posting them publicly. See where they have been, relive the moments, and stay connected across any distance.

## Stay connected across any distance
From weekend getaways to once-in-a-lifetime trips, keep up with what your family is doing. Follow the relatives you care about, see their events in the order they happened, and stop finding out about a graduation three weeks after the fact.

## Your memories are yours
No ads. No data selling. No algorithms. A family-sized space instead of a public one.
- Not public by default - a new event goes to the followers you have approved, not to the open internet, and you can narrow or widen that audience for every event.
- No ads, ever - we will never sell your data or show ads. Your memories are not a product.
- Built for families - made by a family, for families.

## Who can see an event
You choose an audience for every event you create: Followers (the default), Close Family, a Custom Group, Private (only you) or Public (anyone with the link, signed in or not). For anything just for the family, pick Followers, Close Family, a Custom Group or Private.
Want a story nobody else even knows about? Make it Private, and it stays with you alone. Every other event shows its card (title, cover and place) in the feed of signed-in members, and opening the event itself always follows the audience you chose. Visitors who are not signed in can open Public events only.

## What you can do
- Follow family members - see what your family is up to in a chronological feed, with no algorithm hiding posts. Never miss a birthday party, graduation, vacation or Sunday dinner.
- Rich event pages - photo galleries with lightbox viewing, rich text for the full story, comments and likes from family, and every detail that makes a trip worth remembering.
- Interactive maps and timeline - see every trip on an interactive world map, follow multi-location journey maps, and browse a timeline organized by year. Filter by person, category or date.
- GPS extraction from photos - Our Family Socials reads the location data already stored in your photos and suggests the places you visited.
- Video support - add video clips alongside photos, with a built-in trimmer.
- AI Create - add your photos, type or say what happened, and AI Create drafts the story, the headings and a caption for every photo. Part of Pro and the free trial.
- Family trees - a visual family tree built from relationships both people have confirmed.
- Tag profiles - tag children, older relatives or pets who do not have an account yet; they can claim the profile later.
- Audience controls - choose who opens each event, from Public down to a Custom Group such as "close family only" or Private, just for you.

## How it works
1. Create an account at ourfamilysocials.com. Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, and you can publish up to 5 events during it.
2. Follow your family. Send follow requests or email invitations. Once someone accepts, you see each other's events.
3. Share life events. Build an event page with photos, a story, dates and locations, then choose its audience.
4. Stay connected. Browse the feed, the map or the timeline, and comment and like just like a normal social network - only among family rather than in public.

## Common questions
Q: What is Our Family Socials?
A: Our Family Socials is a private social network designed for families. It lets you share life events, photos, and stories with your closest family members and friends. A new event goes to the family you have approved, you choose the audience for every one, and there are no ads and nothing ranked.

Q: Is it really free?
A: Reading is free forever: the free plan lets you open the events of the people you follow and every Public event, follow family members, like and comment. Every new account also gets a 30-day Pro trial with up to 5 published events, and Pro or Lifetime make publishing unlimited.

Q: Who can see my events?
A: You choose who can open every event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a Custom Group, Private (only you) or Public (anyone with the link, with or without an account). Follow requests are yours to accept or decline. A Private event stays with you alone; every other event shows its card (title, cover and place) in the feed of signed-in members, and opening it always follows the audience you chose.

Q: Can I share an event with someone who doesn't have an account?
A: Yes. Make a private share link for any event. Anyone you give it to can open that one event without an account, for 1 to 5 days, your choice.
Read all the answers on the FAQ page.

## Simple, transparent pricing
Start for free. Upgrade when you need more.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, with up to 5 published events (drafts and deleted events do not count). Pro and Lifetime make publishing unlimited. When a trial ends without a plan, the account stays free for reading, liking and commenting, and publishing new events is part of Pro and Lifetime.
- Free to View - $0/forever. View the events you have access to, like and comment, follow family members, interactive maps and timeline, and a 30-day Pro trial with up to 5 published events.
- Pro - $9/month billed annually ($108/year), or $12/month billed monthly. Create unlimited events, photo and video uploads, journey mapping, GPS extraction from photos, privacy controls and a rich text editor.
- Lifetime - $294 once. Everything in Pro, no recurring fees, all future updates, priority support and early access to features.
30-day free trial on all accounts. Subscribe within 5 days for an extra month free.
Your free account keeps the feed, your own events, every event set to Public and the events of the people you follow, all open to you, with likes and comments. Opening everything else, and publishing new events, comes with an active trial or subscription.

- Features - everything Our Family Socials does, in one list.
- Pricing - the free plan, Pro and Lifetime.
- FAQ - answers about privacy, events, billing and sharing.

# Our Family Socials features
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/features

Our Family Socials is a private family social network built around the story: the long version of a trip, a birthday or a Sunday dinner, with your words, your photos, your clips and a map, opened by exactly the people you choose. Here is everything that comes with it, live today.

## A private, chronological family feed
Follow the family members and close friends you care about. Their events appear in a feed in date order, never ranked, so a quiet post about a grandparent's birthday sits right next to a three-week vacation. Following is request-based: every follow request is yours to accept or decline.
- A feed in date order, with nothing ranked
- Follow requests you accept or decline
- Likes, ten reactions and nested replies from the people you have approved
- Email when someone asks to follow you, comments on your story or posts a new one
- Email invitations so you can bring relatives in directly

## Rich event pages instead of single posts
The heart of Our Family Socials is the event, which we also call a story. An event is a trip, a birthday, a graduation or a Sunday dinner, with everything that belongs to it in one place.
- Photo galleries that open full screen, with a slideshow and zoom
- A rich text editor for the story behind the photos, with headings that build a contents list
- Video clips right in the story, with a built-in trimmer to pick the best moment
- Multiple locations per event, for road trips and multi-stop vacations
- Dates, categories and tagged family members
- Drafts that only you can see, and a trash you can restore events from

## Maps, journeys and timeline
Because every event can carry locations, your family history becomes something you can browse by place as well as by date.
- An interactive world map with a pin for every event you can open
- Journey maps that connect the stops of a single multi-location trip, in order
- A timeline view grouped by year, and a calendar view
- Filters by person, category and date range
- Automatic GPS extraction from photo metadata, so locations are suggested for you

## AI Create
Add your photos or clips, then type or simply say what happened. AI Create comes back with a title, a story with section headings, a caption for every photo, a category and a place. AI Draft and AI Interview hand you the draft to polish before it goes out, and Quick Publish posts it straight away. AI Create is part of Pro and the free trial.

## Smart Import
Smart Import takes up to 300 photos at once and sorts them into albums by time and place. The time and place of each photo are read on your device, and only those details, never the pictures, are sent to group them. Your photos upload when you pick an album to turn into a story. Smart Import is part of Pro and the free trial.

## Family trees and relationships
You can record how people are actually related - sister, dad, cousin - and both people confirm the relationship. Confirmed relationships build an interactive family tree. For relatives who are not on Our Family Socials yet (young children, older relatives, even pets) you can create a tag profile, tag them in events, and let them claim the profile when they join.

## Audience and privacy controls
You choose an audience for every event you create: Followers (the default), Close Family, a Custom Group, Private (only you) or Public (anyone with the link, signed in or not). For anything just for the family, pick Followers, Close Family, a Custom Group or Private.
- Five audience settings per event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a Custom Group, Private, or Public
- Public events open for anyone with the link, signed in or not, for the stories you want to share widely
- Private share links open one specific event for someone without an account, for 1 to 5 days
- Follow requests are approved by you, and verified relationships are confirmed by both people
- No advertising anywhere in the product, and no selling of your data
Want a story nobody else even knows about? Make it Private, and it stays with you alone. Every other event shows its card (title, cover and place) in the feed of signed-in members, and opening the event itself always follows the audience you chose. Visitors who are not signed in can open Public events only.

## On every phone, tablet and computer
Our Family Socials runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers. Add it to your phone's home screen today and it opens just like an app, and our iPhone app is on the way.

## What it costs
Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, with up to 5 published events (drafts and deleted events do not count). Pro and Lifetime make publishing unlimited. When a trial ends without a plan, the account stays free for reading, liking and commenting, and publishing new events is part of Pro and Lifetime.
-> Start your free trial: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> See pricing: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing
See also: FAQ, about Our Family Socials and why families are moving to Our Family Socials.

# Simple, transparent pricing
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing

Readers are free, forever. Storytellers start with a 30-day Pro trial, no card needed, and pick Pro or Lifetime to keep publishing. Join more than a million people sharing their private moments with the people who matter to them.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, with up to 5 published events (drafts and deleted events do not count). Pro and Lifetime make publishing unlimited. When a trial ends without a plan, the account stays free for reading, liking and commenting, and publishing new events is part of Pro and Lifetime.

## Free to View - $0/forever
For the whole family of readers.
- Read, like and comment, free forever
- Open the events of the people you follow, and every Public event
- Like and comment
- Follow family members
- Interactive maps & timeline
- 30-day Pro trial included, with up to 5 published events

## Pro - $9/month billed annually, or $12/month billed monthly
For storytellers. Billed annually at $108/year, or monthly at $12/month.

## Lifetime - $294 once
Pay once, use forever.

## Pricing questions
Q: How does the free trial work?
A: Sign up and get Pro for 30 days, with no credit card required, and publish up to 5 events. Subscribe to Pro during the trial and the days you have left are added on before your first renewal. Subscribe within your first 5 days and we add an extra 30 days free on top.

Q: What happens when my trial ends?
A: Your free account keeps the feed, your own events, every event set to Public and the events of the people you follow, all open to you, with likes and comments. Opening everything else, and publishing new events, comes with an active trial or subscription. Pick Pro or Lifetime whenever you are ready, and you are publishing again straight away.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes. Cancel your subscription anytime, with no questions asked. Every event you have published stays right where it is, and you can pick up again whenever you like.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe, our secure payment partner. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

# Our Family Socials FAQ
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/faq

Frequently asked questions about Our Family Socials, a private social network for families. Anything else you would like to know, just email support@ourfamilysocials.com.

## Getting Started
Q: What is Our Family Socials?
A: Our Family Socials is a private social network designed for families. It lets you share life events, photos, and stories with your closest family members and friends. A new event goes to the family you have approved, you choose the audience for every one, and there are no ads and nothing ranked.

Q: Who is Our Family Socials for?
A: It is built for families who want a private place for their memories: parents sharing milestones with grandparents, extended families staying in touch across different countries, and anyone who wants to tell the story of their trips and celebrations to the people who matter, privately.

Q: Is it really free?
A: Reading is free forever: the free plan lets you open the events of the people you follow and every Public event, follow family members, like and comment. Every new account also gets a 30-day Pro trial with up to 5 published events, and Pro or Lifetime make publishing unlimited.

Q: How much does Pro cost?
A: Pro is $9 per month when billed annually ($108 per year) or $12 per month billed monthly. There is also a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account starts with a 30-day free trial of Pro, and no credit card is required to start the trial.

Q: How do I invite my family members?
A: Go to your Profile and you'll find an invite option. You can send email invitations to family members. When they sign up using your invite link, you'll automatically be connected.

Q: Can I use it on my phone?
A: Absolutely. Our Family Socials works beautifully on phones, tablets and computers. Just visit ourfamilysocials.com in your phone's browser.

Q: Is there an app?
A: Yes. Add Our Family Socials to your phone's home screen today, and our iPhone app is on the way.

## Events & Content
Q: What is an "event"?
A: An event, which we also call a story, is a page for something that happened - like a vacation, birthday party, graduation or Sunday dinner - with your writing, a gallery of captioned photos, video clips, dates and places. Think of it as the full story of a moment, all in one place.

Q: How many photos can I add to an event?
A: On Pro and Lifetime an event holds up to 300 photos, and during the free trial up to 50. iPhone HEIC photos are welcome, and every photo is prepared for fast loading so it looks sharp on any screen, while your original files stay safe on your own device.

Q: Can I add locations to my events?
A: Yes. You can add multiple locations to each event, perfect for road trips and multi-destination adventures. We also read the GPS data in your photos to suggest locations, and you can add a place to any photo yourself.

Q: Can I add videos as well as photos?
A: Yes. Add video clips right in the story alongside your photos, on Pro and during the free trial. The built-in trimmer lets you pick the best 60 seconds of each clip.

Q: What's the difference between Published, Drafts, and Trash?
A: Published events are visible to the audience you chose for them. Drafts are works-in-progress that only you can see. Trash keeps the events you delete, so you can restore one whenever you like, or delete it for good.

Q: Do drafts count toward my event limit?
A: No. Only published events count toward the 5 in your trial, so you can keep as many drafts as you like.

Q: Can AI help me write an event?
A: Yes. Add your photos or clips, then type or simply say what happened, and AI Create comes back with a title, a story with section headings, a caption for every photo, a category and a place. AI Draft and AI Interview hand you the draft to polish before it goes out, and Quick Publish posts it straight away to your Followers; you can change the audience whenever you edit the story. AI Create is part of Pro and the free trial.

## Privacy & Sharing
Q: Who can see my events?
A: You choose who can open every event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a Custom Group, Private (only you) or Public (anyone with the link, with or without an account). Follow requests are yours to accept or decline. A Private event stays with you alone; every other event shows its card (title, cover and place) in the feed of signed-in members, and opening it always follows the audience you chose.

Q: Can I share an event with someone who doesn't have an account?
A: Yes. Make a private share link for any event. Anyone you give it to can open that one event without an account, for 1 to 5 days, your choice.

Q: Can I make an event public?
A: Yes. Public is one of the five audience settings, and a public event can be opened by anyone who has the link, with or without an account. Our robots.txt asks search engines and AI crawlers not to index event pages. For anything just for the family, pick Followers, Close Family, a Custom Group or Private.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: Yes. We take privacy seriously. We never sell your data, never show ads, and never rank what you see. Your photos and stories are yours, and we're just here to help you preserve and share them with family.

Q: Does Our Family Socials show ads?
A: No. There is no advertising anywhere in the product and we do not sell your data. The product is paid for by Pro and Lifetime subscriptions, which is why there is a price on the pricing page instead of an ad slot in your feed.

Q: Can I delete my account?
A: Yes. Email us at support@ourfamilysocials.com and we'll delete your account and all associated data for you.

## Following & Relationships
Q: How do I follow someone?
A: Search for them by username or find them through your existing connections. Send a follow request, and once they accept, you'll see their events in your feed.

Q: What are verified relationships?
A: Verified relationships let you formally connect family members (like marking someone as your "sister" or "dad"). Both parties must confirm the relationship. This helps build your family tree and adds context to your connections.

Q: What are tag profiles?
A: Tag profiles let you tag people who don't have accounts yet - like young children, elderly relatives, or pets. You can create a profile for them and tag them in events. If they later join, they can claim their profile.

## Maps & Timeline
Q: How does the map view work?
A: The map view shows every event with a location on an interactive world map, with nearby pins grouped together. See where your family has traveled and tap a pin to open that event. It's a beautiful way to see your family's adventures.

Q: Can I see events from multiple family members on one map?
A: Yes. See every event you can open on a single map, or filter by family member to follow one person's journeys.

Q: What is the timeline view?
A: The timeline view shows events organized chronologically, grouped by year. It's a visual history of your family's memories over time.

## Subscription & Billing
Q: What's included in the free trial?
A: Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, including photo and video uploads, journey mapping, GPS extraction, AI Create and Smart Import, with up to 5 published events. When the trial ends you keep a free account for reading, liking and commenting, and Pro or Lifetime picks your storytelling up right where you left off.

Q: How do I upgrade to Pro?
A: Go to Settings > Membership from your profile page. You can choose monthly ($12/mo) or annual ($9/mo billed yearly) billing. We also offer a one-time Lifetime option.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe, our secure payment partner. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes. Cancel your subscription anytime, with no questions asked. Your events and data stay right where they are, and you can pick up again whenever you like.

Q: What happens to my events if I downgrade?
A: Your events stay exactly as they are, and you can always open them yourself. Sharing them with your family and publishing new ones come with an active subscription, so the moment you resubscribe, everyone can open your stories again.
-> Start your free trial: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> Contact us: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/contact
See also: features, pricing and about Our Family Socials.

# About Our Family Socials
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/about

Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network made for families to share life events, photos and memories together. A new event goes to the family you have approved, you choose the audience for every one, and the feed is in date order with nothing ranked. Join more than a million people sharing their private moments with the people who matter to them.

## Why it exists
We built Our Family Socials for our own family: one place where the long version of our lives could live, from the road trip to the school play, shared with the people who already know the kids' names. It gives every family a space of its own to keep their memories the way they deserve, and to come back to them for years.

## What makes it ours
- You choose the audience - a new event goes to the followers you have approved, and you can set any event to Close Family, a Custom Group such as "close family only", Private (just you) or Public (anyone with the link).
- No ads, ever - we will never sell your data or show you ads. Your family memories are not a product to be monetized.
- Rich event pages - photo galleries, detailed stories, multiple locations and GPS-tagged journey maps.
- Interactive maps and timeline - see your family's adventures on an interactive world map, and watch years of memories unfold in order.
- AI Create - add your photos, type or say what happened, and AI drafts the story for you to make your own.
- Built for families - made by a family, for families. We use Our Family Socials ourselves to stay close to our own loved ones.

## How it works
1. Create an account - sign up for free at ourfamilysocials.com. You get a 30-day Pro trial automatically, with up to 5 published events during it.
2. Follow your family - send follow requests to family members. Once they accept, you see each other's events.
3. Share life events - create event pages with photos, stories, locations and dates. Choose the audience for each event.
4. Stay connected - view your family's events in the feed, on the map or in the timeline. Comment, like and cheer each other on.

## Who it is for
- Parents sharing kids' milestones with grandparents
- Extended families staying close across any distance
- Travelers telling the story of every trip with photo albums and maps
- Anyone who wants to share their life privately with the people who matter
- Families who value privacy and want to keep their memories ad-free

## Pricing
Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, with up to 5 published events (drafts and deleted events do not count). Pro and Lifetime make publishing unlimited. When a trial ends without a plan, the account stays free for reading, liking and commenting, and publishing new events is part of Pro and Lifetime.
-> Sign up free: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> View pricing details: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing
See also: features, the FAQ and why families are moving to Our Family Socials.

# Why more than a million people are moving to Our Family Socials
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/alternatives
Last updated: November 2026

Join more than a million people sharing their private moments with the people who matter to them. Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free family social network built around the story: the long version of a trip, a birthday or an ordinary Tuesday, with your words, captioned photos, video and a journey map, opened by exactly the people you choose.

## A whole story for every moment
A story is a page of its own for something that happened: what you did, in your words, with a gallery of captioned photos, video clips right where they belong, the dates and the places. Add a few headings and the page builds its own contents list. Short on time? Add the photos, say what happened, and AI Create writes the first draft. In the app, a story is called an event.

## You decide who opens it
Every story carries its own audience. Choose from five:
- Private: just you, until you make a share link for it.
- Custom Group: a named list you build from the people you follow, such as "Run club" or "The cousins".
- Close Family: the followers you have marked as close family.
- Followers: everyone whose follow request you accepted. New stories start here.
- Public: anyone with the link, signed in or not.
Want to send one story to someone without an account? Make a share link. It opens that one story for anyone you give it to, for 1 to 5 days, your choice.

## Every trip on a map, every year on a timeline
The places come from your photos. Our Family Socials reads where and when each photo was taken, right in your browser, and every located photo becomes a numbered stop on the story's journey map, joined in order by a dashed line. Then the whole family history opens four ways: a feed in date order, a calendar, a world map with a pin for every story, and a timeline by year.

## No ads. Nothing ranked.
Nothing here is ranked. Stories from the people you follow arrive in date order, by the day they were posted or the day they happened, your choice. There are no ads anywhere in Our Family Socials and we never sell your data. Filter by person, category or date range whenever you want to find something.

## Readers are free
Readers are free, forever: grandparents, cousins and friends read, like and comment on the stories of the people they follow without paying a thing. The plans: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.

## Coming from somewhere else?

### Coming from a private Facebook group?
Bring the group with you. Everyone you invite reads for free, every story goes to exactly the audience you pick, and the feed runs in date order with no ads. See what your group gets here.

### Coming from Tinybeans?
Keep every milestone, and make room for the whole family. Grandparents, aunts and cousins tell their stories too, on one timeline and one map that grow up with your kids. See what your family gets here.

### Coming from FamilyAlbum?
Turn the photos into stories. Smart Import sorts a big batch into albums by time and place, AI Create writes it up from a few words, and every trip gets its own journey map. See what your photos get here.

### Coming from a private Instagram account?
Tell the long version. A story has room for all the writing, photos and clips the day deserves, and you choose who opens each one, story by story. See what your stories get here.

### Sharing photos of the kids with grandparents?
Here is what to look for, and how to do it step by step. Read the guide to sharing kids' photos privately.
-> Start free: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> See all features: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/features

# Coming from a private Facebook group? Welcome to Our Family Socials.
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/facebook-groups
Last updated: November 2026

Join more than a million people sharing their private moments with the people who matter to them. Bring your family group with you, and give every trip, birthday and Sunday dinner the room it deserves: a whole story, opened by exactly the people you pick.

## Every moment gets its own story
On Our Family Socials, each moment gets a page of its own: your writing, a gallery of captioned photos, video clips, the dates, and a journey map of everywhere you went. Add a few headings and the page builds a contents list for you, and every story ends with a gallery of everything that opens full screen as a slideshow. In the app, a story is called an event.

## You decide who opens each story
Every story carries its own audience, so the bath-time video and the big family reunion can go to different people. Choose from five:
- Private: just you, until you make a share link for it.

- Close Family: the followers you have marked as close family.
- Followers: everyone whose follow request you accepted. New stories start here.
- Public: anyone with the link, signed in or not.
Want to send one story to someone without an account? Make a share link. It opens that one story for anyone you give it to, for 1 to 5 days, your choice.

## A feed in date order, with no ads
Nothing here is ranked. Stories from the people you follow arrive in date order, by the day they were posted or the day they happened, your choice. There are no ads anywhere in Our Family Socials and we never sell your data. Filter by person, category or date range whenever you want to find something.

## Your family on a map and a timeline
The places come from your photos. Our Family Socials reads where and when each photo was taken, right in your browser, and every located photo becomes a numbered stop on the story's journey map, joined in order by a dashed line. Then the whole family history opens four ways: a feed in date order, a calendar, a world map with a pin for every story, and a timeline by year.

## Bringing the family over

# How to share kids' photos privately with family
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/how-to-share-photos-privately
Last updated: November 2026

Grandparents want to see every first tooth and every school play, and you want those photos kept inside the family. Here is what to look for in a private way to share, and how to do it step by step on Our Family Socials. Join more than a million people sharing their private moments with the people who matter to them.

## What to look for
- You choose the audience - every photo and every story should go to exactly the people you pick. On Our Family Socials, each story has one of five audiences, from Private to Public.
- A new story starts with family - on Our Family Socials a new story goes to the followers you have approved, never to the open internet.
- No ad targeting - your family photos should never feed an advertising profile. Our Family Socials has no ads and never sells your data.
- Easy for grandparents - readers are free forever, sign-up takes an email address, and a share link opens one story with no account at all.
- Organized by occasion - a trip should stay together as one story, with its words, photos, clips and map.
- Easy to find in ten years - a timeline by year, a calendar and a world map of every story keep everything findable.

## How to do it on Our Family Socials
1. Start free. Create an account at ourfamilysocials.com. Your 30-day Pro trial starts right away, no card needed.
2. Invite the family. Send grandparents, aunts and uncles an email invitation; you are connected as soon as they sign up with it. Reading is free for them, forever.
3. Add the photos, then just talk. Pick your photos and clips, type or say what happened, and AI Create drafts the story with a caption for every photo. Or write it yourself.
4. Choose who opens it. Pick Private, a Custom Group, Close Family, Followers or Public for each story.
5. Share a link with anyone else. A share link opens that one story for someone without an account, for 1 to 5 days.

## The five audiences
- Private: just you, until you make a share link for it.
- Custom Group: a named list you build from the people you follow, such as "Run club" or "The cousins".
- Close Family: the followers you have marked as close family.
- Followers: everyone whose follow request you accepted. New stories start here.
- Public: anyone with the link, signed in or not.

## Getting grandparents on board
- Sign-up takes an email address, and reading is free forever.
- Private share links send one story to someone who would rather not sign up for anything.
- It works on any device - phone, tablet or computer - right in the browser. Add it to the home screen today, and our iPhone app is on the way.
- Email invitations bring a relative straight in, with no searching for your name.

## Keep it organized for years
The places come from your photos. Our Family Socials reads where and when each photo was taken, right in your browser, and every located photo becomes a numbered stop on the story's journey map, joined in order by a dashed line. Then the whole family history opens four ways: a feed in date order, a calendar, a world map with a pin for every story, and a timeline by year.
Nothing here is ranked. Stories from the people you follow arrive in date order, by the day they were posted or the day they happened, your choice. There are no ads anywhere in Our Family Socials and we never sell your data. Filter by person, category or date range whenever you want to find something.

## What it costs
Readers are free, forever: grandparents, cousins and friends read, like and comment on the stories of the people they follow without paying a thing. The plans: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294.
